author: Lex Walters
text: When my own landlord refused to help us with an emergency septic situation, Sunrise stepped up and took care of everything. Thank God for Paul, I will never use another septic business, he was patient, efficient, and very professional. Thank you, Sunrise Septic!!

author: Brenda Nelson
text: I highly recommend this company! Called him yesterday morning and he was at my home at 4:30 same afternoon. I so appreciate his prompt, knowledgeable and affordable service!

author: Ginger Jederberg
text: We called Sunrise Septic on a Sunday afternoon with a backed up septic system. Even though Paul was on his way back from a long trip he answered the phone and said he would be out to help.  After arriving home he immediately came out and was able to get our system functioning. He spent two days pumping and repairing our septic system.  Very professional, reliable and easy to work with.  We had him place us on a service plan. Will recommend him to family and friends.

author: Cynthia Picard
text: My sewer backed up due to a running toilet. Called Paul and he said he would stop by and look at my system.  He advised me as to what to do until he could make it over.   Paul looked at my system and determined the water overload from toilet caused my issue.  He took the time to check my tank for solids.  I did not need a drain done  I appreciated his honesty and helpfulness.  I asked to be set up on a maintenance schedule for future needs. Integrity at its finest,

author: Trevor Peterson
text: Called a different septic place. They were super busy. Referred us to sunrise septic. They came out a few days later. Super easy to deal with. Paul was awesome and efficient with the work. Thank you sunrise….
